questions.question: The hip musculature involves several muscle groups for different actions. Hip abduction takes place with nerve innervation from the superior gluteal nerve. Which muscles compose the hip abductor group?

options.B: Gluteus medius, gluteus minimus, tensor fasciae latae

questions.explanation: The hip abductors are gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae (superior gluteal nerve).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The specific gravity of the human body is
questions.explanation: The specific gravity of the human body is about 0.95.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Normally in the standing position the center of gravity lies:

options.A: 5 cms anterior to second sacral vertebra
options.B: 5 cms posterior to second sacral vertebra
options.D: 5 cms anterior to second lumbar vertebra

questions.explanation: In standing the centre of gravity lies about 5 cm anterior to the second sacral vertebra.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 10

questions.question: Vector is a physical force that has:

options.D: Fixed point of application of force

questions.explanation: A vector has both magnitude and direction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 7

questions.question: In the second order lever the arrangement is:

options.A: Weight in middle, fulcrum and effort point are either end
options.B: Fulcrum is in middle, weight and effort point are on either end
options.C: Effort point is in middle, weight and fulcrum are on either end

questions.explanation: In a second-class lever the weight lies between fulcrum and effort.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 28

questions.question: The body's center of gravity in an adult normally has up and down movements of:
questions.explanation: In walking the centre of gravity rises and falls about 2.5 inches (5 cm).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 449

questions.question: If a plumb line is positioned laterally to a patient so it runs along the line of gravity, where should the line fall with respect to the midline of the knee?
questions.explanation: The line of gravity passes slightly anterior to the knee axis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 412

questions.question: Which type of contraction occurs when the force of the muscles is less than the resistance?
questions.explanation: Eccentric contraction occurs when muscle force is less than the resistance and the muscle lengthens.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Principles of Exercise Therapy/Gardiner/4th Ed./Pg. 22

questions.question: Minimum intradiscal pressure in vertebral column is seen when a person is:
questions.explanation: Intradiscal pressure is lowest when lying flat.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Orthopedic Physical Assessment/Magee/5th Ed./Pg. 523

questions.question: Tightness of tensor fascia latae causes:
questions.explanation: A tight tensor fasciae latae/iliotibial band pulls the knee into valgus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 311

questions.question: The ligaments of the hip are very weak: Biomechanics 59
questions.explanation: The hip capsule is weakest posteriorly.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 298

questions.question: Normal angle between vertical lines of femur and tibia is:
questions.explanation: The normal femorotibial (tibiofemoral) angle is about 7 degrees valgus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 450

questions.question: The main dorsiflexor of foot is:
questions.explanation: Tibialis anterior is the main dorsiflexor.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Kinesiology of Musculoskeletal System/Neuman/Pg. 510
